turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Good afternoon, how can I help you today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hi!

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I need to return an item

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I can look in to that for you. May I ask what was wrong with the item?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I'm simply not liking it much. I looks so different form the picture they put on the description

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: No problem, just to verify, you have already received the item and you want to return it?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Actually, the item is not shipped yet

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Ok, then this will be a refund. can I get your full name or account ID?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Norman Bouchard, and the id is EPFRFWVQE7

turns.speaker: system_action
turns.text: Account has been pulled up for Norman Bouchard.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks Norman. I pulled up your account and need to validate the purchase. Do you have your username, email address and Order ID?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Sure, user name is normanbouchard195, email is normanbouchard195@email.com, and the order id is 7800407924

turns.speaker: system_action
turns.text: Purchase validation in progress ...

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I was able to validate your purchase. How would you like your refund?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I'd like it to be refunded to me credit card. thanks

turns.speaker: system_action
turns.text: A reason of Credit Card has been recorded.

turns.speaker: system_action
turns.text: Details of EPFRFWVQE7 have been entered.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: What was the cost of the item Norman?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: It was 79 bucks

turns.speaker: system_action
turns.text: A refund has been made for the amount of $79.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Alright, I have credited your card for $79. Is there anything else I can help you with today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I really appreciate it. Thank you and have a great day.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks, you too!
